text:
Alex Chen: Quick sync — we need to ingest partner SOC2 + pen-test artifacts for ACME Cloud listing. Who owns S3 collection and redaction? timeline: 2 weeks. cc @Priya Singh
Priya Singh: I'll take coordination. Can security list exact required artifacts + expected naming scheme?
Mei Park: Required: SOC2 Type II full report (PDF), pen-test executive summary + vuln CSV, remediation plan (doc), internal scan results (nmap/qualys), questionnaire answers (PDF/markdown), attestation signed by partner. Also need contact email + PGP key if partner requests. No PII in screenshots. Link: https://redwood.internal/marketplace/compliance-checklist
Sam B: For uploads, we should give them presigned PUT URLs to a restricted S3 prefix: s3://redwood-marketplace/partners/{partner-id}/{date}/artifacts/. I can generate presigns with 24h expiry. Example CLI: `aws s3 presign s3://redwood-marketplace/partners/acme/2026-03-21/artifacts/report.pdf --expires-in 86400`
Sam B: We'll enforce server-side KMS: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/redwood-marketplace. Partner uploads go to a quarantine bucket with object lock 30d, then moved to archive after review.
Jordan Lee: Who does redaction? Legal or Partnerships? Also we need to preserve hash/manifest for audit.
Priya Singh: Partnerships will collect and do initial redaction stub (PII scrub), but final signoff from Legal (cc @Mei Park for security review). We'll attach manifest.json listing file hashes.
Mei Park: Redaction rules: no credentials, remove AWS account IDs, mask email addresses, crop screenshots to remove usernames. We'll run a quick scan using `scripts/scan-artifacts.sh` to flag potential secrets.
compliance-bot: [automated] New checklist created: marketplace-acme-2176543210, presign endpoints will be valid for 24h. Reminder: keep all artifacts in encrypted bucket. :lock:
Alex Chen: Ok, deliverables and owners: Partnerships (collect + initial redaction) — @Priya Singh; Security (technical review + manifest) — @Mei Park; Eng infra (upload infra + presigns) — @Sam B; Legal (final redaction signoff) — TBA. Target internal review by 2176560000 (two weeks).
Priya Singh: I'll ping the partner today and request files + contact info. I'll add the partner's SI and HW integrator in the ask if applicable. Will share upload links in this thread.
Jordan Lee: One more — do we require a pen-tester's signed scope letter? Some marketplaces ask for assessor attestation.
Mei Park: Yes, include assessor name, date, scope, CVE cutoff, and whether retest was performed. If external, ask for signed letter or report header with assessor contact.
Alex Chen: Great. Priya — can you confirm by EOD and paste the presign template here? :thumbsup:
Priya Singh: Yep, will confirm by EOD and post presign template + checklist. Thanks everyone.
